Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and players make their way back onto the field. Ryan Scott and Ritwik Behera to open the innings for USA. Mark Adair to start proceedings with the ball.
...The Run Chase ...

Now then. 151 is the target for USA to win the series here. Their top order did not have the best of games in the first T20I but they would be hoping to do better here. What will happen in the second half? Stay with us to find out.

USA had a brilliant game with the ball. All the bowlers except for Ali Khan were quite economical and kept the pressure on. More importantly, they took wickets at regular intervals which didn't let Ireland seize the momentum. Saurabh Netravalkar was the pick of the bowlers with 3 important wickets while Nisarg Patel, Yasir Mohammad and Vatsal Vaghela took 2 wickets each.

It was all about Lorcan Tucker as far as the Irish batting is concerned. None of their other batters clicked and Tucker kept running out of partners in this innings. But his brilliant 84-run knock has taken them to a pretty decent score here.
The Irish batting may have faltered but Tucker has got them to a pretty decent score on the board here. If the Irish bowl well, we could have a cracker on our hands.

OUT! BOWLED! Finally, Lorcan Tucker has been dismissed and that draws curtains on the Irish innings. A leg stump yorker from Saurabh Netravalkar and Tucker looks to reverse it yet again. The ball is just too quick and sneaks under the bat of Tucker and crashes into leg stump. Ireland have been bundled out for 150!
Back of a length, around off and this is tapped towards cover-point.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Length again, on off. Tucker goes for the switch hit and the ball goes through the hands of the fielder at cover-point and into the fence. 150 is up for Ireland.
Slower in pace and outside off. Tucker makes room and slices it towards backward point.
A length ball, around off. White opens the face of the bat and nudges it past point for a single.
Change. Saurabh Netravalkar (3-0-28-0) is back on.
SIX! WOW! Khan misses the block hole and Tucker takes full advantage. Another half-volley, around off. Tucker stays deep and smokes it high and over the long off fence for a huge hit.
FOUR! In the slot, around off. Tucker frees his arms and thumps it back over the bowler's head for a boundary. He's played a gem of an innings tonight.
Fullish ball, on middle and leg. White pushes it down to long on for one.
Benjamin White is the last man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Unreal from the skipper, Monank Patel! An inswinging yorker, directed at the pads. Tucker looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes off the pads and goes behind, the batters try to scamper through for a leg bye. Monank Patel is lightning quick as he dives down to his left and without even taking off his gloves, throws it back onto the stumps. Barry McCarthy is short of his crease and just the one wicket remains now for Ireland.
A length ball, outside off. Tucker stays leg side and looks to go big downtown but only manages to swing through thin air.
SIX! Dispatched! In the slot, around middle. Lorcan Tucker hangs back and whips it over the square leg fence for a biggie.
Close! Quicker one, around off and it's the googly yet again. Barry McCarthy strides out to defend but gets rapped on the pads. Huge appeal but not given, maybe hitting outside the line.

OUT! CAUGHT! Soft dismissal and Simi Singh is livid with himself! Tossed up, around off stump. Singh premeditates the reverse sweep and picks out the fielder at short third man. Ali Khan takes a sharp catch and Lorcan Tucker loses yet another partner. Barry McCarthy is in now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ali Khan b Yasir Mohammad

Commentary.Commentary: LEG BYE! Around middle and leg, Tucker looks to flick it on the leg side but misses. The ball goes off the pads and they get a leg bye.
FIVE WIDES! Poor delivery and poor fielding too. Very full and very wide, Tucker looks to reverse sweep but can't get any bat on it. The ball runs away into the third man fence as well.
Here comes the googly, on middle and turning down leg. Singh pulls it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Shorter one, around the hips. Simi Singh hops on the back foot and flicks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Dragged down, on middle. Tucker pulls it hard and through mid-wicket for just a single though.
Change. Yasir Mohammad (2-0-21-1) is back on.
Very full, on the pads. Tucker nudges it towards mid on for another single.
Simi Singh comes down the track again and Khan follows him with an inswinging yorker. Singh jams it out on the off side and picks up a run.
Fullish ball, on the pads. Tucker flicks it uppishly towards long on for a single.
A length ball, on top of off and driven towards mid off for a quick single.

Well bowled! Right in the block hole, Singh looks to come down the track and heave it on the leg side. The ball goes off the inside edge and past leg stump. The fielder at fine cuts it off and keeps it to two.
Slingy yorker, on leg stump. Singh steps out and makes it a full toss but only manages to tap it back to the bowler.
Quick single as the batters set off after Singh taps it to covers.
A single as this is pushed to long on.
Shorter and on off. Pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Driven past covers for one.
Tucker comes down the track and drives it to long off for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Singh guides it away for one.
Back of a length this time, around middle and leg. Singh clips it past square leg and gets a single.
Simi Singh is the new man in.
OUT! BOWLED! Back of a length, around off. Adair goes for the pull but gets no bat on it. The ball clips the leg pole and the bails come off!
On a length, around off. Adair pushes it to covers for one.
Back of a length, on the pads. Tucker works it past square leg for one.
Back of a length, on off. Adair pulls it away for a single.
Length ball, on off. Pushed away for one.

Adair comes down the track and drills it to long off. They look for the second and the throw comes in at the keeper's end. The bails come off and Adair could be short but the keeper right away signals that he did not have the ball in his hands while taking the bails off.
Darted on the pads. Worked past square leg for one.
Mark Adair is in at number 8.

OUT! TAKEN! WHAT A CATCH! Wow, that is a stunner! Tossed up, on off. William McClintock goes for the slog sweep but gets the top edge. The ball goes high in the air towards long on. Marty Kain runs in from the fence, dives forward and takes the catch just inches above the ground!
Commentary.Howout: c Marty Kain b Nisarg Patel

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and outside off. Punched away for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed past covers for one.
Darted around off. Tucker runs it towards short third man for one.
Nisarg Patel (2-0-16-1) comes back into the attack.
Loopy ball, around off. Pushed to covers.
Shorter and punched away for one.
William McClintock walks out to bat now.
OUT! TAKEN! Vatsal Vaghela gets his second wicket now! Tossed up, outside off. Rock dances down the track and chips it towards long on. Ritwik Behera takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Ritwik Behera b Vatsal Vaghela

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on off. Rock chips it back over the bowler for a couple.
Pulled down to long on for one.
Dropped! Tucker hits it straight back but Vatsal Vaghela puts down an easy chance. How costly will that be?
Darted on the pads. Tucker works it to deep mid-wicket and brings up his 50. He has been really good in the series.
Tossed up, on the pads. Rock sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
A single as this is pushed to long off.
Tossed up, on off. Pushed past cover for one.
Flatter and on off. Eased to short third man for one.
On off, pushed down the ground towards long off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Vatsal Vaghela has his first wicket in international cricket and Shane Getkate is back in the hut! Vaghela holds it back a touch and bowls it around off. The ball is well flighted and Shane Getkate falls for the bait. Getkate dances down the track but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball as he ends up lifting it straight back over the bowler's head. Ritwik Behera from long off settles under it and takes a fine catch. Neil Rock comes in at number 6.
Commentary.Howout: c Ritwik Behera b Vatsal Vaghela

Commentary.Commentary: Slightly shorter and this is broomed away onto the leg side for one.
Tossed up, on off. Getkate looks to go big downtown but mistimes it badly. The ball goes aerially but falls short of long on. They get a single.
Flatter delivery, on middle and pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Quicker through the air this time, around off. Lorcan Tucker moves across the stumps and sweeps it hard behind square on the leg side and picks up another boundary.
This is dragged down but Tucker can only manage to pull it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around the off pole, Tucker looks to reverse sweep but can't pierce the infield.
Did that carry? On off and this is driven uppishly but straight towards cover-point.
FOUR! Fullish ball, on off. Lorcan Tucker gets inside the line of the ball and paddles it fine, past the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
A touch short and wide, cut away to deep point for one.
Slightly shorter, on off and turning in. Getkate looks to sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball rolls onto the leg side.
On middle, Tucker works it through mid-wicket for another one.
Flighted again, dropping late on the batter. Getkate can only manage to push it back to the bowler.
Dragged down, outside off and Tucker pulls it straight towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Loopy ball, at the pads. Getkate waits for it and eases it towards wide long on for one.
Slower through the air this time and it's on a length as well. Getkate nudges it out on the off side.
Nicely flighted, on the pads. Tucker works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Vatsal Vaghela is set to bowl on his debut.
Tossed up, on middle and driven down the ground for another single.
It's the googly once again. On middle and leg, Getkate pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Here comes the wrong 'un. Around off and turning in, Getkate just manages to defend it out.
A touch short and wide, cut away off the back foot. The fielder at point makes a half-stop and they get a single.

FOUR! Edgy boundary. Slowed up, around off and turning away. Tucker gets beaten in flight as he looks to drive at it. The ball runs away towards third man where the fielder fumbles and the ball goes into the fence.

OUT! CAUGHT! Curtis Campher goes for one big shot too many and holes out. Nicely tossed up, around middle and enticing the batter to go big. Curtis Campher gets on one knee and looks to slog it over long on but ends up mistiming it. The ball goes high and Marty Kain takes a good catch around the long on fence. Shane Getkate is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Marty Kain b Yasir Mohammad

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one, on a length and outside off. Tucker taps it to cover-point for a quick single. The fielder misses the shy at the batter's end and they get an overthrow as well. Ireland are 59/2 at the end of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Cheeky! On middle, Tucker shuffles across his stumps and scoops it over the keeper's head for another boundary.
A length ball, on off and angled across. Tucker mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket.
Fullish ball, around off and this is driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Short of a length, on off and this one sits up nicely. Lorcan Tucker pulls it hard and into the backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, around leg stump. Tucker punches it off the back foot to mid on.
Saurabh Netravalkar (1-0-14-1) is back into the attack.
Shorter and outside off. Campher cuts it to covers.
Loopy ball, around off. Pushed to covers.
A single as this is pushed to long on.
Tucker punches it to cover.
Flatter and on off. Pushed to covers for one.
SIX! Boom! That is launched away! Loopy ball, outside off. Campher gets low and sweeps it straight down the ground for a maximum.
A change from both ends now as Yasir Mohammad is into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely done! Length and on the pads. Tucker flicks it wide of deep square leg for a boundary. 11 from that over, an expensive one by Ali Khan.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
SIX! Beautiful stroke! Tucker gets a nice length ball, on middle. He clears the front leg and lifts it over the wide long on fence.
Back of a length, outside off. Tucker nicely plays it to cover.
Short of a length, around off. Punched past covers for one.
Length and on the pads. Campher gets hit on the pads while looking to flick.
Ali Khan comes on to bowl now.
Flatter and on off. Cut away to point for one.
FOUR! Cut away this time! Patel shortens his length and bowls it shorter and outside off. Campher cuts it away for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Darted on leg. Campher backs away and lifts it over mid on for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out by Campher.
Flatter and on middle. Pushed to mid on for one.
Loopy and on off. Blocked out.
Curtis Campher is the new man in.
OUT! TAKEN! He goes just like he got out in the first game! Short of a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie pulls it away but straight to the man at deep square leg. Sushant Modani takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sushant Modani b Saurabh Netravalkar

Commentary.Commentary: Tucker guides this short ball past backward point for one.
FOUR! Good shot! Full and on off. Tucker flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flicked towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! Again! Fuller and outside off. This is driven through covers by Andy Balbirnie for another boundary.
FOUR! Short of a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie rocks back and cuts it away for a boundary.
Lorcan Tucker comes in at number 3. It's going to be Saurabh Netravalkar to bowl from the opposite end.
OUT! LBW! He is plumb this time! Full and on middle. Stirling gets low to sweep it away but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal again and this time Paul Stirling is given the marching orders.
Loopy ball, around off. Paul Stirling goes for the sweep but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but not given.
Full and on off. Blocked out by Paul Stirling.
Pushed past mid off for one.
Flatter and on off. Punched to covers for one.
We are set! Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling are set to open for Ireland. USA opt to start with spin as Nisarg Patel has been handed the new ball.
FOUR! Smashes! Shorter and outside off. Paul Stirling rocks back and cuts it away for a boundary.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they would have bowled too. Adds that they are hoping and will try to bounce back here. Mentions that they have discussed the last game and want to do better this time. Informs that they are playing the same side.

Monank Patel, the skipper of USA, says that they are playing with an extra spinner and the dew factor will come in in the second innings, so will look to restrict the opposition. Adds that they will look to continue the momentum and there is one change in the team as Vatsal Vaghela makes his debut.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Lorcan Tucker, Curtis Campher, Shane Getkate, Neil Rock (WK), William McClintock, Mark Adair, Simi Singh, Barry McCarthy, Benjamin White.

USA (Playing XI) - Gajanand Singh, Monank Patel (C)(WK), Marty Kain, Ali Khan, Nisarg Patel, Ritwik Behera, Ryan Scott, Saurabh Netravalkar, Sushant Modani, Vatsal Vaghela (In for Xavier Marshall), Yasir Mohammad.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of the hosts! USA will bowl first!

Ireland were left dumbfounded when they were beaten by USA in the first T20I. They had taken 4 early wickets when the score was just 16 but couldn't deal the final blow and paid a hefty price for it. The visitors will be desperate for a victory here and that can be good or bad. If they regroup and go in with a calm mindset, they should be able to get on level terms but if the hosts put them under a bit of pressure, we might see another upset. So, will the series be won by USA here? Or will it be drawn 1-1?

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd T20I between USA and Ireland. The hosts created history in the first match by coming back from the clutches of death and went on to beat a Test-playing nation. After the top order faltered, Modani, Singh and Kain helped the hosts put on a big score and the bowlers then held their nerves to claim a win to remember.
... Match Day ...
